hints.title: Friendship Graph Direct Neighborhood
hints.text: Retrieve user 1 friends by checking friendship connections in either user1_id or user2_id directions.

hints.title: Distinct Recommended Pages Union
hints.text: join the retrieved friends list with the likes table and filter out pages user 1 already likes.

hints.title: Page Recommendations Blueprint
hints.text: select distinct page_id as recommended_page from Likes where user_id in (select user2_id from Friendship where user1_id = 1 union select user1_id from Friendship where user2_id = 1) and page_id not in (select page_id from Likes where user_id = 1).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT DISTINCT page_id AS recommended_page
FROM Likes
WHERE user_id IN (
    SELECT user2_id FROM Friendship WHERE user1_id = 1
    UNION
    SELECT user1_id FROM Friendship WHERE user2_id = 1
)
AND page_id NOT IN (
    SELECT page_id FROM Likes WHERE user_id = 1
);
```

complexity.notes: Filtering by user 1 friends and anti-joining against user 1 likes runs in linear time using indices.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to union bidirectional friendship records misses friends logged in reverse order.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Union of friend ids into an in-memory hash set avoids complex outer joins.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Bidirectional friendship handling and exclusion of already-liked pages.

solutions.approach: PostgreSQL Subquery Filter with Set Exclusion

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def page_recommendations(friendship: pd.DataFrame, likes: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    f1 = friendship[friendship['user1_id'] == 1]['user2_id']
    f2 = friendship[friendship['user2_id'] == 1]['user1_id']
    friends = set(f1).union(set(f2))
    user1_likes = set(likes[likes['user_id'] == 1]['page_id'])
    rec = likes[likes['user_id'].isin(friends) & (~likes['page_id'].isin(user1_likes))]
    res = rec[['page_id']].drop_duplicates().rename(columns={'page_id': 'recommended_page'})
    return res
solutions.approach: Pandas Set Union and Boolean Filtering
